title: same_day_stale_bounce_stands_down_test fixture degenerates to cross-day during 00:00-01:00 UTC
detail: now()-1h crosses midnight ~1/24 of runs; the lexical format-mix bug ('T' > ' ') also classifies cross-day sends as pre-correction, so the W1 pin passes under the buggy code in that window. Narrow but real blind spot on a load-bearing pin.
recommended_fix: Anchor corrected_at deterministically (explicit UPDATE corrected_at = now() with the send at a fixed same-day literal) or fail-fast when the send's date != correction's date.
